database.name: StructureGen demonstration dataset
database.description: Demonstration data shipped with StructureGen so that every feature can be exercised out of the box. Replace it with your own authoritative section data.
database.notes: DEMONSTRATION DATA - NOT VERIFIED. Every record in this file carries "verified": false. The values are widely published nominal figures, transcribed for demonstration and NOT checked against controlled copies of the standards. StructureGen flags unverified records in the palette, on the bill of materials and in the exported workbook. Verify every dimension and unit weight against your own authoritative source before using output from this dataset for procurement, fabrication or construction.
